title: Maheswar Neog Rachanavali Vol. 1 (মহেশ্বৰ নেওগ ৰচনাৱলী - ১ম খণ্ড)
author: Prof. Maheswar Neog (Ed. Dr. Nagen Saikia)
description: Collected academic works of Prof. Maheswar Neog comprising his masterly studies on epigraphy, royal copperplate charters, temple inscriptions, and the historical interaction between Buddhism, Saktism, and indigenous Tai religion in Upper Assam.
source: Guwahati: Dr. Maheswar Neog Trust & Bani Mandir, Archive ID: in.ernet.dli.2015.451213
